statement:
The record shows that **Dane Rusk** is named as the person collecting Leo Barros, but he is **not authorised** to do so (he is neither on the approved list nor permitted by court order).

I will **not** authorise Dane Rusk and will instead **authorise Ana Barros**, the only approved family member available.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states Dane Rusk is "not authorised" — "neither on the approved list nor permitted by court order" — and refuses the collection.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
